gtav.title: GRAND THEFT AUTO-V
gtav.description: To stay alive in a brutal city where no one can be trusted, not even each other, they have to carry out a series of risky robberies. Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore Los Santos and Blaine County in 4K and 60 FPS, with a wide range of customization options and rich gameplay.

systemRequirements.Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad Q6600 @ 2.40GHz / AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core @ 2.5GHz

gowr.title: GOD OF WAR RAGNAROCK
gowr.description: God of War Ragnarök is an action-adventure game where Kratos and his son Atreus travel across the Nine Realms to prevent the prophesied end of the world, Ragnarök. While battling Norse gods and monsters, they must confront their past and make difficult choices about the safety of the realms and their family. The gameplay features a mix of exploration and combat, with Kratos using his signature Leviathan Axe and Blades of Chaos, along with new abilities for both him and Atreus. The game also emphasizes the father-son relationship, with Atreus playing a more active role in both combat and story progression.

systemRequirements.Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 5500 XT (8GB) or Intel Arc A750

wd.title: WATCH DOGS
wd.description: The Watch Dogs series is an open-world action-adventure game franchise centered on a modern-day hacker protagonist who uses their skills to control the urban infrastructure and fight against powerful entities. Players can hack into various city systems, such as traffic lights and security cameras, to gain tactical advantages, solve puzzles, and advance a narrative-driven plot, which varies for each game in the series..

systemRequirements.OS: Windows Vista (SP2), Windows 7 (SP1) or Windows 8 (Please note that we only support 64 bit OSs.)
systemRequirements.Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad Q8400 @ 2.66Ghz or AMD Phenom II X4 940 @ 3.0Ghz
systemRequirements.Graphics: DirectX 11 graphics card with 1 GB Video RAM - Nvidia Geforce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD 5770

nfs.title: NEED FOR SPEED: MOST WANTED
nfs.description: Need for Speed: Most Wanted is an open-world racing game developed by Criterion Games and published by Electronic Arts. Players compete in illegal street races, evade police pursuits, and explore a vast open city called Fairhaven. The game emphasizes high-speed chases, car customization, and a social-driven competition system known as Autolog that tracks player performance and challenges friends in real time.

systemRequirements.OS: Windows Vista (SP2), Windows 7, Windows 8, or later (64-bit OS recommended)
systemRequirements.Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.4 GHz or AMD Athlon X2 2.8 GHz
systemRequirements.Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible GPU with 512 MB Video RAM - NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GT or AMD Radeon HD 3870

wd2.title: WATCH DOGS 2
wd2.description: Watch Dogs 2 is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. Players take on the role of Marcus Holloway, a young hacker in San Francisco, who joins the hacker group DedSec to expose corrupt corporations and government surveillance. The game emphasizes hacking, parkour, stealth, and exploration of a detailed and vibrant city environment, with a mix of story missions and side activities.

systemRequirements.Processor: Intel Core i5-2400s @ 2.5 GHz or AMD FX-6120 @ 3.5 GHz
systemRequirements.Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2 GB VRAM)

msm2.title: Marvel’s Spider‑Man 2
msm2.description: Marvel’s Spider‑Man 2 is an open‑world action‑adventure game developed by Insomniac Games (PC version optimized by Nixxes Software) and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players take on the roles of Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they face a new symbiote threat and a familiar nemesis in a sprawling version of New York City that now includes Brooklyn and Queens. The game emphasizes web‑swinging traversal, dual‑character gameplay, upgrading powers, hacking via high‑tech gadgets, exploration, and a mix of story missions and side activities.

systemRequirements.Processor: Intel Core i3‑8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
systemRequirements.Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (4 GB VRAM)

uncharted.title: UNCHARTED™: Legacy of Thieves Collection
uncharted.description: UNCHARTED™: Legacy of Thieves Collection includes the critically acclaimed single-player adventures of UNCHARTED 4: A Thief’s End and UNCHARTED: The Lost Legacy, remastered and optimized for PC with enhanced graphics, UI, and performance options.

systemRequirements.Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
systemRequirements.Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 570 (4 GB)

modernCombat3.title: Modern Combat 3: Fallen Nation
modernCombat3.description: Modern Combat 3: Fallen Nation is a first-person shooter mobile game developed by Gameloft. Although it doesn’t have an official native PC version, it can be played on Windows using Android emulators like BlueStacks. The game offers fast-paced FPS action, a single-player campaign, and multiplayer battles on mobile, adapted for PC play through emulation.
